description: This file contains the server-side logic for a sign-up webpage in an online examination system. It handles user registration, including saving user information and profile images to the database, and navigation between pages.

classes.name: SignUpPage
classes.description: Code-behind class for the SignUpPage ASP.NET webpage, managing user registration logic.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event, currently does nothing.

methods.name: loginB_Click
methods.description: Handles login button click, navigates to the login page.

methods.name: signUpB_Click
methods.description: Handles the sign-up process, including password validation, saving user data to database, image upload, and user notification.
